businessName: The Artisan House Bakery, Cafe & Restaurant
whatsappMessage:
Hi Team The Artisan House Bakery,

I noticed your bakery & restaurant has strong 4.1★ reviews with over 1,000 ratings in Kidwaipuri, but lacked a dedicated mobile page for table reservations and menu orders.

Maine aapke cafe ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table booking, popular menu items, aur gallery integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/theartisanhouse

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team The Artisan House Bakery, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant (The Artisan House) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp table booking, mobile-first menu showcase, and your strong 4.1-star reputation in Kidwaipuri. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact dishes, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
